020
021public class SurveyPluginImpl implements SurveyPlugin {
022        
023        public static int FLAT_SUPPLIES = 10;
024        
025        public static int BASE_MACHINERY = 10;
026        public static int BASE_CREW = 50;
027        public static int BASE_SUPPLIES = 10;
028        public static int MIN_SUPPLIES_OR_MACHINERY = 5;
029        
030        public static float MIN_PLANET_RADIUS = 70;
031        public static float MAX_PLANET_RADIUS = 250;
032        public static float MULT_AT_MAX_PLANET_RADIUS = 5;
033        
034        
035        private CampaignFleetAPI fleet;
036        private PlanetAPI planet;
037        
038        private MutableStat costMult = new MutableStat(1f);
039        private MutableStat xpMult = new MutableStat(1f);
040
041        public void init(CampaignFleetAPI fleet, PlanetAPI planet) {
042                this.fleet = fleet;
043                this.planet = planet;
044                
045                float hazard = getHazardMultiplier();
046                if (hazard != 1f) {
047                        costMult.modifyMult("planet_hazard", hazard, "Hazard rating");
048                }
049                float size = getSizeMultiplier();
050                if (size != 1f) {
051                        costMult.modifyMult("planet_size", size, "Planet size");
052                }
053                
054                xpMult.applyMods(costMult);
055                
056                if (fleet != null) {
057                        MutableFleetStatsAPI stats = fleet.getStats();
058                        MutableStat stat = stats.getDynamic().getStat(Stats.SURVEY_COST_MULT);
059                        for (StatMod mod : stat.getMultMods().values()) {
060                                costMult.modifyMult(mod.source, mod.value, mod.desc);
061                        }
062                }
063                
064        }
065        
066        protected float getHazardMultiplier() {
067                float hazard = planet.getMarket().getHazardValue();
068                return hazard;
069        }
070        
071        protected float getSizeMultiplier() {
072                float radius = planet.getRadius();
073                float range = MAX_PLANET_RADIUS - MIN_PLANET_RADIUS;
074                if (range <= 0) return 1f;
075                if (radius < MIN_PLANET_RADIUS) radius = MIN_PLANET_RADIUS;
076                if (radius > MAX_PLANET_RADIUS) radius = MAX_PLANET_RADIUS;
077                
078                float mult = 1f + ((radius - MIN_PLANET_RADIUS) / range) * (MULT_AT_MAX_PLANET_RADIUS - 1f);
079                
080                mult = (int)(mult * 20) / 20f;
081                
082                return mult;
083        }
084        
085
086        public Map<String, Integer> getRequired() {
087                Map<String, Integer> result = new LinkedHashMap<String, Integer>();
088                
089                float mult = getCostMult().getModifiedValue();
090                
091                float crewMult = 1f;
092                float machineryMult = 1f;
093                if (Misc.isExtended()) {
094                        crewMult = Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_surveyCrewMult");
095                        machineryMult = Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_surveyMachineryMult");
096                }
097                
098                int machinery = (int)Math.round(BASE_MACHINERY * mult * machineryMult);
099                machinery -= (int) Misc.getFleetwideTotalMod(fleet, Stats.getSurveyCostReductionId(Commodities.HEAVY_MACHINERY), 0);
100                machinery = Math.round(machinery / 10f) * 10;
101                if (machinery < MIN_SUPPLIES_OR_MACHINERY) machinery = MIN_SUPPLIES_OR_MACHINERY;
102                
103                int crew = (int)Math.round((int)(BASE_CREW * mult * crewMult) / 10f) * 10;
104                
105                
106                
107                result.put(Commodities.CREW, crew);
108                result.put(Commodities.HEAVY_MACHINERY, machinery);
109                
110                return result;
111        }
112        
113        public Map<String, Integer> getConsumed() {
114                Map<String, Integer> result = new LinkedHashMap<String, Integer>();
115                
116                float suppliesMult = 1f;
117                if (Misc.isExtended()) {
118                        suppliesMult = Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_surveySuppliesMult");
119                }
120                
121                float mult = getCostMult().getModifiedValue();
122                int supplies = (int)Math.round(BASE_SUPPLIES * mult * suppliesMult);
123                supplies += FLAT_SUPPLIES;
124                supplies = Math.round((int) supplies / 10f) * 10;
125                supplies -= (int) Misc.getFleetwideTotalMod(fleet, Stats.getSurveyCostReductionId(Commodities.SUPPLIES), 0);
126                if (supplies < MIN_SUPPLIES_OR_MACHINERY) supplies = MIN_SUPPLIES_OR_MACHINERY;
127                result.put(Commodities.SUPPLIES, supplies);
128                
129                return result;
130        }
131        
132        public MutableStat getCostMult() {
133                return costMult;
134        }
135
136        public long getXP() {
137                float xp = 0;
138                
139                if (planet.getMarket() != null) {
140                        for (MarketConditionAPI mc : planet.getMarket().getConditions()) {
141                                xp += getBaseXPForCondition(mc.getId());
142                        }
143                }
144                xp *= getXPMult().getModifiedValue();
145                
146                return (long) xp;
147        }
148        
149        public long getBaseXPForCondition(String conditionId) {
150                long xp = 0;
151                
152                float base = Global.getSettings().getFloat("baseSurveyXP");
153                ConditionGenDataSpec data = (ConditionGenDataSpec) Global.getSettings().getSpec(ConditionGenDataSpec.class, conditionId, true);
154                if (data != null) {
155                        xp += base * data.getXpMult();
156                }
157                return xp;
158        }
159        
160        public MutableStat getXPMult() {
161                return xpMult;
162        }
163        
164        
165        public String getImageCategory() {
166                return "illustrations";
167        }
168
169        public String getImageKey() {
170                return "survey";
171        }
172
173        public String getSurveyDataType(PlanetAPI planet) {
174                if (planet.getMarket() == null) return null;
175                
176                int count = 0;
177                float value = 0;
178                for (MarketConditionAPI mc : planet.getMarket().getConditions()) {
179                        if (DerelictThemeGenerator.interestingConditionsWithRuins.contains(mc.getId())) {
180                                count++;
181                        }
182                        if (mc.getGenSpec() != null) {
183                                //value += mc.getGenSpec().getXpMult();
184                                value += mc.getGenSpec().getRank();
185                        }
186                }
187                
188                if (planet.getMarket().hasCondition(Conditions.HABITABLE)) {
189                        value += 4f;
190                }
191                
192                float hazard = planet.getMarket().getHazardValue();
193                value -= (hazard - 1f) * 2f;
194                
195                if (value <= 5) return Commodities.SURVEY_DATA_1;
196                if (value <= 8) return Commodities.SURVEY_DATA_2;
197                if (value <= 11 && count <= 1) return Commodities.SURVEY_DATA_3;
198                if (value <= 14 && count <= 2) return Commodities.SURVEY_DATA_4;
199                return Commodities.SURVEY_DATA_5;
200                
201//              if (value <= 10 && count <= 0) return Commodities.SURVEY_DATA_1;
202//              if (value <= 20 && count <= 0) return Commodities.SURVEY_DATA_2;
203//              if (value <= 30 && count <= 1) return Commodities.SURVEY_DATA_3;
204//              if (value <= 40 && count <= 2) return Commodities.SURVEY_DATA_4;
205//              return Commodities.SURVEY_DATA_5;
206
207//              too few class V with below approach
208//              if (count <= 0) return Commodities.SURVEY_DATA_1;
209//              if (count <= 1) return Commodities.SURVEY_DATA_2;
210//              if (count <= 2) return Commodities.SURVEY_DATA_3;
211//              if (count <= 3) return Commodities.SURVEY_DATA_4;
212//              return Commodities.SURVEY_DATA_5;
213        }
214
215        
216        public Map<String, Integer> getOutpostConsumed() {
217                Map<String, Integer> result = new LinkedHashMap<String, Integer>();
218                
219                if (Misc.isExtended()) {
220                        result.put(Commodities.CREW, Global.getSettings().getInt("ext_establishColonyCrew"));
221                        result.put(Commodities.HEAVY_MACHINERY, Global.getSettings().getInt("ext_establishColonyMachinery"));
222                        result.put(Commodities.SUPPLIES, Global.getSettings().getInt("ext_establishColonySupplies"));
223                } else {
224                        result.put(Commodities.CREW, 1000);
225                        result.put(Commodities.HEAVY_MACHINERY, 100);
226                        result.put(Commodities.SUPPLIES, 200);
227                }
228                
229                
230                return result;
231        }

233}
